description: Localization service interface for Tempo.Blazor components. Provides translated strings by indexer. The library ships English, Czech, Slovak and French. Counted texts use Loc.Plural (Key_One/_Few/_Many/_Other, see TmLocalizerPluralExtensions). Culture is the UI culture that picks plural rules and resource patterns; a null Culture falls back to CurrentUICulture. TryGetString looks a key up without falling back to the key text. Both are default interface members.

methods.name: this[string]
methods.description: Gets the localized string for the specified key.

methods.name: this[string, object[]]
methods.description: Gets the formatted localized string with arguments.

methods.name: Culture
methods.description: The UI culture whose string table this localizer serves, and whose plural rules apply. Defaults to CurrentUICulture.

methods.name: TryGetString
methods.description: Looks a key up without falling back to the key text.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The unformatted resource text when found.

examples.title: Custom localizer implementation
Registration
Reword shipped translations with a decorator (registered after AddTempoBlazor())
examples.setupNote: Register the decorator AFTER AddTempoBlazor() — TryAddSingleton skips the built-in DefaultTmLocalizer when the application registered ITmLocalizer first, and the last registration wins in .NET DI. The decorator injects the built-in IStringLocalizer<TmResources> (registered by AddTempoBlazor()) so every key it does not list keeps the shipped translation. Caveat: counted texts resolve the plural family (Key_One/_Few/_Many/_Other), not the plain key — to reword them, list the family keys (e.g. TmModelingIssuePanel_Count_One, as the map above does) in the override map; overriding the plain key alone is bypassed by Loc.Plural. This exact class is compiled and exercised by the test suite (tests/Tempo.Blazor.Tests/Localization/DocumentedTranslationOverrideLocalizer.cs).

examples.title: Replace the whole language table instead of single keys
examples.setupNote: A new built-in language is a new TmResources.<culture>.json embedded with WithCulture=false and LogicalName Tempo.Blazor.Resources.TmResources.<culture>.json; the JsonStringLocalizer resolves it by naming convention from CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture. Slovak plural rules (one/few/many/other) are already built into TmPluralRules.
